name: BESKONECHNOYE LETO: NE ZNAKOMY LAGER
source:
Sanya got Lena's good ending. He got on bus No. 410 and ended up in Sovyonok.
A familiar camp. Familiar faces. Only Slavya asks, "Who are you?"
Lena looks at him like a stranger. And at night, outside the door, someone speaks in his own voice.

Sanya thought he knew the rules of this game. The camp is ready to prove otherwise.

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826491064]Steam[/url]]
translation:
萨尼亚打出了莉娜的好结局。随后他登上了410路公交车，结果自己也来到了“小猫头鹰”夏令营。
熟悉的营地，熟悉的面孔。唯独斯拉维亚开口问道：“你是谁？”
莉娜用看待陌生人的眼神打量着他。而到了夜晚，门外竟有人用他自己的声音说话。

萨尼亚原以为自己对这场游戏的规则了如指掌，而这座夏令营正准备证明他大错特错。

[摘自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3826491064]Steam[/url]]
